aiDlpGuard.blockOnSave.description: Block sensitive content at save time by sanitizing matched ranges.

aiDlpGuard.blockOnCommit.description: Require clean staged diff before secure commit command proceeds.

aiDlpGuard.entropyThreshold.description: Entropy threshold for high-randomness token detection.

aiDlpGuard.blockThreshold.description: Score above this value is blocked.

aiDlpGuard.warnThreshold.description: Score above this value is warned.

aiDlpGuard.userRole.description: Role used by Rocket AI Shield policy manager for allow/warn/block decisions.

aiDlpGuard.autoPromptFirewallRealtime.description: Automatically run Prompt Firewall on typed/pasted editor content in realtime.

aiDlpGuard.autoResponseFirewallRealtime.description: Automatically run Response Firewall on inserted editor content in realtime.

aiDlpGuard.realtimeProvider.description: Provider label used for realtime firewall audit and policy decisions.

aiDlpGuard.realtimeMinChars.description: Minimum changed text size before automatic realtime firewall inspection starts.

aiDlpGuard.securityEngineMode.description: Security engine mode: fast=current scanner only, balanced=Presidio on risky files, strict=always dual-scan with Presidio when available.

aiDlpGuard.presidioEndpoint.description: Presidio analyzer endpoint used in balanced/strict modes.

aiDlpGuard.presidioLanguage.description: Language sent to Presidio analyzer for NLP detection.

aiDlpGuard.presidioScoreThreshold.description: Minimum Presidio confidence score to include a finding.

aiDlpGuard.presidioTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for Presidio analyze requests.

aiDlpGuard.presidioMaxChars.description: Maximum text size sent to Presidio analyzer per scan to control latency.

aiDlpGuard.tokenVaultEnabled.description: Store encrypted reversible mappings for Tokenize Data placeholders in .rocket-ai-shield/token-vault.jsonl (key kept in VS Code SecretStorage).

rocketAIShield.autoOptimizeContext.description: Automatically optimize prompt/context text before running Prompt Firewall inspection.

rocketAIShield.costPer1kTokensUsd.description: Cost model used for AI Efficiency Dashboard estimated savings (USD per 1000 tokens).

rocketAIShield.smartContextScope.description: Scope used by Build Smart Context: activeFile scans only the opened file; workspace uses top relevant files from the repository.

rocketAIShield.clipboardGuardEnabled.description: Continuously prepare clipboard content for Copilot chat by applying optimization and prompt firewall tokenization.

rocketAIShield.clipboardGuardPollMs.description: Polling interval for clipboard middle-layer guard. Lower values are more responsive with higher CPU usage.

rocketAIShield.clipboardGuardMinChars.description: Minimum clipboard text length before automatic optimization/security processing starts.

rocketAIShield.clipboardGuardProvider.description: Provider label used for policy and audit when preparing clipboard text for Copilot chat.

rocketAIShield.clipboardGuardNotify.description: Show confirmation notifications when clipboard text is prepared by Rocket AI Shield.

rocketAIShield.clipboardGuardShowBadge.description: Show a live status-bar badge with before/after token reduction when clipboard text is secured for Copilot chat.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run compile-tests
